scenarios.title: The Thread of Ariadne (as rules)
scenarios.description: The main quest, converted to rules from data/main_quest.json: one step per stage. Enable it only if you turn the built-in story off - otherwise both run.

args.step: 1 Dock at Kephala Outpost
1 Dock at Kephala Outpost

args.text: Dock at Kephala Outpost

lines: The Atrapos sector was named by its first surveyors after [b]Atropos[/b] - eldest of the three Fates of Greek myth, the one who cuts the thread of every life.
Pilots joke that out here, the thread is always short.
For three nights now, every receiver in the sector has picked up the same faint signal: a slow spiral of symbols, repeating, from somewhere beyond the charted lanes.
Kephala Outpost to any independent pilot: Dr. Ariadne Kephala requests assistance with the anomalous signal. Please dock at Kephala Outpost. Paying work.

args.step: 1 Dock at Kephala Outpost
2 Find the source of the signal
2 Find the source of the signal

args.text: Find the source of the signal

lines: Thank you for coming. I'm an archaeologist - Aegean Bronze Age, Crete mostly. Which is why this signal is keeping me awake.
It isn't noise. It's 45 distinct symbols, stamped out one by one in a spiral, read from the rim toward the centre.

That is exactly the structure of the [b]Phaistos Disc[/b] - a clay disc found in a Minoan palace on Crete in 1908. 241 stamped signs, 45 different ones, spiralling on both faces. Nobody has ever read it.
I've triangulated the source to the east of here. I've marked it on your map. Please - go and look.

args.step: 2 Find the source of the signal
3 Destroy the raiders at the signal
3 Destroy the raiders at the signal

args.text: Destroy the raiders at the signal source

lines: Something is drifting at the heart of the signal - small, reddish, turning slowly. It isn't metal.
Wait, I'm reading other ships near you. Raiders - they're flying a red bull's head as their banner.
They must have followed the signal too. Don't let them take it!

args.step: 3 Destroy the raiders at the signal
4 Recover the disc fragment
4 Recover the disc fragment

args.text: Recover the disc fragment

lines: The raiders are gone. Can you get close to that object?
...It's fired clay. A fragment of a disc, covered in stamped signs. Fired clay, floating in deep space. That's impossible. Bring it in, carefully.

args.step: 4 Recover the disc fragment
5 Bring the fragment to Kephala Outp
5 Bring the fragment to Kephala Outp

args.text: Bring the fragment to Kephala Outpost

lines: Come straight back to Kephala Outpost. I'll have the lab ready.

args.step: 5 Bring the fragment to Kephala Outp
6 Bring 4 Energy Cells and 6 Titaniu
6 Bring 4 Energy Cells and 6 Titaniu

args.text: Bring 4 Energy Cells and 6 Titanium Ore to Kephala Outpost

lines: Look at the edge of the fragment. This second band of signs isn't Phaistos-style at all. It's [b]Linear A[/b] - the everyday script of the Minoans.
Linear A has never been deciphered. The Mycenaean Greeks later adapted it into Linear B, and an English architect, Michael Ventris, cracked Linear B in 1952. But Linear A still keeps its secrets.
Except - this fragment resonates. Feed it energy and the signs shift, like the disc is trying to teach us to read it.
I need a resonator: [b]4 Energy Cells[/b] to power it and [b]6 Titanium Ore[/b] for the frame. Wrecks carry cells; titanium comes from the blue-grey asteroids.

args.step: 6 Bring 4 Energy Cells and 6 Titaniu

args.text: Still needed: 4 Energy Cell, 6 Titanium Ore

rules.note: Stage 6: reminder when something is missing

args.step: 6 Bring 4 Energy Cells and 6 Titaniu
7 Follow Ariadne's Thread: first bea
7 Follow Ariadne's Thread: first bea

args.text: Follow Ariadne's Thread: first beacon

lines: It worked. The Linear A band is a list of places - star positions. Each one points to the next.
In the myth, Princess Ariadne of Crete gave Theseus a ball of thread so he could find his way out of the Labyrinth. This is a thread through the dark - and I'm afraid I'm going to name it after her.
The first point is north of Knossos Station. Follow the thread.

args.step: 7 Follow Ariadne's Thread: first bea
8 Follow Ariadne's Thread: second be
8 Follow Ariadne's Thread: second be

args.text: Follow Ariadne's Thread: second beacon

lines: The beacon wakes as you arrive. A double-headed axe of light turns slowly above it - a [b]labrys[/b].
A voice-less message unfolds in Linear A, and the fragment in your hold translates: [i]Ka-no-so. The house of a thousand rooms. Its columns are red, wider at the top than at the foot.[/i]
Knossos! The greatest Minoan palace - more than a thousand rooms around a central court, with those famous tapering red columns. Arthur Evans dug it up from 1900 onward.
There's another position encoded. Keep going.

args.step: 8 Follow Ariadne's Thread: second be
9 Follow Ariadne's Thread: third bea
9 Follow Ariadne's Thread: third bea

args.text: Follow Ariadne's Thread: third beacon

lines: The second beacon shows the labrys again, and a new line: [i]The double axe marks the holy places. Its house is the labyrinth.[/i]
One theory says 'labyrinth' really meant 'house of the labrys' - the double axe was the Minoans' most sacred symbol.
The last point is far to the north-west. Be careful - the raiders with the bull banner have been seen out that way.

args.step: 9 Follow Ariadne's Thread: third bea
10 Defeat Asterion and his escorts
10 Defeat Asterion and his escorts

args.text: Defeat Asterion and his escorts

lines: The third beacon shows a painted scene: young athletes somersaulting over the back of a charging bull. Then a final position - and a structure, vast and old, waiting there.
Pretty little lights, aren't they? I've followed them for a year. Did the woman at Kephala tell you what's at the end of the thread?
They call me [b]Asterion[/b]. The Bull of Minos. Whatever sleeps in that Labyrinth belongs to me - and you are flying straight toward my doorway.
Asterion - that was the Minotaur's own name in the old stories. He's no monster, just a warlord with a flagship. Take him down!

args.step: 10 Defeat Asterion and his escorts
11 Find the shipwright at Helios Dock
11 Find the shipwright at Helios Dock

args.text: Find the shipwright at Helios Dock

lines: Asterion's flagship breaks apart. Beyond the wreckage, the structure is finally clear: a ring of rings, a maze the size of a station, wrapped in a shimmering seal.
It's a labyrinth - the classic seven-ring Cretan design, the one stamped on the coins of Knossos. And it's sealed.
There is one person who might build a key: Nikos Daidalos, the shipwright at Helios Dock. Yes, really. He's heard every joke.

args.step: 11 Find the shipwright at Helios Dock
12 Bring 3 Alien Alloy and 2 Platinum
12 Bring 3 Alien Alloy and 2 Platinum

args.text: Bring 3 Alien Alloy and 2 Platinum Ore to Helios Dock

lines: A labyrinth, a sealed door, and a girl named Ariadne. My namesake would laugh. Daedalus built the Labyrinth for King Minos - and then built wings to escape Crete with his son, Icarus.
I can tune a key to that seal. I'll need [b]3 Alien Alloy[/b] - light as feathers - and [b]2 Platinum Ore[/b]. The gold-veined rocks.
Bring them and I'll build you a key... and a pair of wings while I'm at it.

args.step: 12 Bring 3 Alien Alloy and 2 Platinum

args.text: Still needed: 3 Alien Alloy, 2 Platinum Ore

rules.note: Stage 12: reminder when something is missing

args.step: 12 Bring 3 Alien Alloy and 2 Platinum

args.text: Reward: afterburner (equipment rewards aren't a rules action yet)

args.step: 13 Return to the Labyrinth with the k
13 Return to the Labyrinth with the k

args.text: Return to the Labyrinth with the key

lines: Your key is fitted. And the wings - an afterburner, tuned by my own hand. Fly fast, but remember Icarus: he flew too close to the sun, the wax melted, and he fell into the sea.
Now go. And if anything in that Labyrinth is made of bronze... call me.

args.step: 13 Return to the Labyrinth with the k
14 Defeat Talos, the bronze guardian
14 Defeat Talos, the bronze guardian

args.text: Defeat Talos, the bronze guardian

lines: As you approach the Labyrinth, something huge unfolds from its outer ring. Bronze plates glow like a forge.
That's... Talos. The bronze giant who guarded Crete. He walked around the island three times every day, hurling rocks at any ship that came near.
Every Talos has one weakness: a single vein, sealed by a bronze nail at the ankle. Keep hitting him - don't let his shields recover!

args.step: 14 Defeat Talos, the bronze guardian
15 Enter the heart of the Labyrinth
15 Enter the heart of the Labyrinth

args.text: Enter the heart of the Labyrinth

lines: Talos falls silent, the glow fading from his bronze. The seal around the Labyrinth flickers, and opens.
Follow the path to the centre. Like Theseus - except this time, nobody needs to die in there.

args.step: 15 Enter the heart of the Labyrinth
16 The thread is complete
16 The thread is complete

args.text: The thread is complete

lines: At the centre of the Labyrinth is not a monster, but an archive. Thousands of clay discs turn slowly in the dark, each one stamped in spirals.
The fragment in your hold slots into an empty place among them. And for the first time in more than three thousand years, the Linear A begins to speak.
[i]We are the Keftiu - the people of the island the Egyptians traded with. Our palaces had no walls; the sea was our wall.[/i]

[i]Then the mountain of Thera tore itself apart, and ash fell like black snow, and the sea rose against our harbours. Later, ships came from the mainland, and other kings sat in our palace and wrote in their own tongue.[/i]
[i]We could not keep our island. So we kept our memory. Whoever follows the thread to this place: read us. Remember us.[/i]
They wanted to be remembered. That's all. Not treasure - memory. I'll spend the rest of my life reading this archive, and I'll never be bored again.
Atropos cuts every thread in the end. But not this one. Not today. Thank you, pilot.
[b]The main quest is complete.[/b] The sector is still yours to explore - and the archive will be waiting.

args.step: 16 The thread is complete

scenarios.title: The Olive and the Owl
scenarios.description: The Athenian League's story: Athena's sacred olive withers with salt in its roots. An oracle, an offering to the Earth-shaker, a battle in the narrows and a runner's race.

rules.note: The quest begins at Athenai Stoa

args.step: Not started

lines: Sing, Muse, of the pilot who came to the city of grey-eyed Athena, when her olive withered and the sea rose against her people.

Long ago, men say, two gods strove for the land: Poseidon struck the rock with his trident and a salt spring leapt out; Athena planted an olive. The people chose the olive, and the city took her name.
Welcome, stranger. Sit, eat, and then tell me your name - so the custom of our fathers commands, and so I keep it.
Hear our grief. The olive in the garden-ring of the Akropolis, grown from the seed of the goddess's own tree, is withering. Salt is in its roots, and no engineer can say how it came there.
When the wise do not know, the wise ask. Go to the silver mines of Laurion in the Marathon system. The priestess Diotima keeps the bronze owl there; it speaks with the voice of the goddess.

args.step: 1 Seek the bronze owl at the mines of Laurio
1 Seek the bronze owl at the mines of Laurio

args.text: Seek the bronze owl at the mines of Laurion (Marathon system)

lines: Laurion: a grey moon riddled with old shafts, where the city's silver was dug by men who never saw the sun. There the owl keeps its watch.

args.step: 1 Seek the bronze owl at the mines of Laurio

lines: You come as the goddess said you would - unasked, and in a hurry. Sit. The owl does not speak to the hurried.
The sea's lord was robbed and has not forgotten. Where the cape of Sounion faces the dawn, thieves drank from his altar. Find them, and the salt will leave the root.
Sounion lies in the system of Athenai itself. The Sea Peoples have a den beyond our gates; it was they, surely.

args.step: 2 Destroy the thieves at the cape of Sounion
2 Destroy the thieves at the cape of Sounion

args.text: Destroy the thieves at the cape of Sounion (Athenai system)

lines: At Sounion the raiders sat round their fires like wolves round a felled stag, and the bronze trident of Poseidon lay among them, black with soot.

args.step: 2 Destroy the thieves at the cape of Sounion

lines: So the thieves fell, and the trident of the Earth-shaker lay in the pilot's hold - heavy as a guilty conscience.
You have the god's trident? Then do not keep it an hour longer than you must. Gods are not asked twice. Bring gifts with it to the harbour-shrine at Piraeus: oil, wine and bread, as our fathers did.

args.step: 3 Bring 10 Food and 4 Luxury Goods to the sh
3 Bring 10 Food and 4 Luxury Goods to the sh

args.text: Bring 10 Food and 4 Luxury Goods to the shrine at Piraeus Emporion (Piraeus system)

lines: Do not haggle over the gifts, pilot. A man who bargains with a god has already lost.

args.step: 3 Bring 10 Food and 4 Luxury Goods to the sh

lines: They poured the wine on the deck of the harbour-shrine and burned the bread, and the smoke went up to the dark between the stars.
The Earth-shaker has his trident and his gifts. Now set the trident back where it was taken, on the cape of Sounion, and say his name as you do it.

args.step: 4 Return the trident to the cape of Sounion
3 Bring 10 Food and 4 Luxury Goods to the sh

args.text: Still needed here: 10 Food, 4 Luxury Goods

args.step: 4 Return the trident to the cape of Sounion

args.text: Return the trident to the cape of Sounion (Athenai system)

lines: Then the pilot turned the ship back towards Sounion, carrying the god's own weapon through the god's own sea.

args.step: 4 Return the trident to the cape of Sounion

lines: The trident was set in its place, and the pilot said the god's name. Far off, the gates of Athenai flickered once, as if a wave had passed through them, and were still.
The salt is leaving the roots! But listen - the Sea Peoples have heard who robbed them of their prize. Their ships gather beyond Piraeus to burn our harbour.

args.step: 5 Join Navarch Themistios at Piraeus Emporio
5 Join Navarch Themistios at Piraeus Emporio

args.text: Join Navarch Themistios at Piraeus Emporion (Piraeus system)

lines: In Piraeus the ships lay side by side like spears in a rack, and their crews sharpened their weapons and said little.

args.step: 5 Join Navarch Themistios at Piraeus Emporio

lines: They are many and we are few. So we will not meet them in open space. We will meet them in the narrows before the gate to Ugarit, where their numbers are a burden and not a strength.
An oracle once told our fathers to trust in wooden walls. Our walls are hulls now. Yours is one of them.

args.step: 6 Hold the narrows at the gate to Ugarit
6 Hold the narrows at the gate to Ugarit

args.text: Hold the narrows at the gate to Ugarit (Piraeus system)

lines: As starlings wheel over a field before rain, so the raiders came through the gate, wheeling and crying on their radios.

args.step: 6 Hold the narrows at the gate to Ugarit

lines: Their van is broken. But see - their great ships come behind, and their chief with them. Do not let them pass.

args.step: 7 Destroy the raiders' chief and his gunship
7 Destroy the raiders' chief and his gunship

args.text: Destroy the raiders' chief and his gunships in the narrows (Piraeus system)

lines: Owl-folk! I will hang your ships from my mast like a fisher hangs his catch!

args.step: 7 Destroy the raiders' chief and his gunship

lines: So the chief fell in the narrows, and the sea of stars was strewn with wrecks as a beach is strewn with weed after a storm.
Victory! Now the city must hear it before rumour reaches it first - rumour is quicker than any ship. Run, pilot, to the Stoa at Athenai, and do not stop.

args.step: 8 Run the news to Athenai Stoa before the ho
8 Run the news to Athenai Stoa before the ho

args.text: Run the news to Athenai Stoa before the hour turns (Athenai system)

lines: Once a runner ran from Marathon to the city with news of victory, spoke one word, and died. The pilot flew, and hoped for a kinder ending.

args.step: 8 Run the news to Athenai Stoa before the ho

args.text: Too late - but fly on all the same.

args.step: 8 Run the news to Athenai Stoa before the ho

lines: Rejoice - we have won! You came faster than the rumour. The city will remember it.

args.step: 8 Run the news to Athenai Stoa before the ho

lines: Rumour came before you, pilot, but it told the truth this once. No matter - you are here, and alive.

args.step: 8 Run the news to Athenai Stoa before the ho

lines: That day the people walked in procession round the Akropolis-ring, as at the great festival, and carried a new robe to the goddess.
And look: the olive puts out new leaves. Grey-eyed Athena has seen it all. Take this, and take the city's thanks - you are a guest-friend of Athens, now and always.

scenarios.title: With Your Shield or On It
scenarios.description: The Spartan Hegemony's story: a trial of the agoge, an oracle against greed, the pass of Thermopylai held against a traitor's raiders, the Twin Stars relit and Cerberus driven back at Tainaron.

rules.note: The quest begins at Sparta Barracks

args.step: Not started

lines: Sing, Muse, of Lakedaimon, the hollow land, whose people spend few words and many years of training - and of the stranger who stood among them.
You. Pilot. We have a task. We do not give tasks to men we have not tested.
Raiders prowl the gate to Pylos. Three of them. Go alone. Come back.
When a king of Macedon wrote to them, 'If I enter your land I will destroy you,' the Spartans answered with one word: 'If.'

args.step: 1 Destroy the three raiders at the gate to P
1 Destroy the three raiders at the gate to P

args.text: Destroy the three raiders at the gate to Pylos (Sparta system) - alone

lines: Spartan boys were sent out alone, with no shoes and one cloak, to live by their wits. The ephor asked the stranger for less than that - and watched closely all the same.

args.step: 1 Destroy the three raiders at the gate to P

lines: Now the real task. Go to the shrine at Amyklai. The priest has an answer from Delphi. We do not like it.

args.step: 2 Hear the oracle at the shrine of Amyklai
2 Hear the oracle at the shrine of Amyklai

args.text: Hear the oracle at the shrine of Amyklai (Sparta system)

lines: Amyklai. The shrine of Apollo, where Hyakinthos died. Listen to the priest. Speak little.

args.step: 2 Hear the oracle at the shrine of Amyklai

lines: Far-shooting Apollo gave this answer to our kings long ago, and gives it again: 'Love of money, and nothing else, will destroy Sparta.'

Now hear what the god did not say, but we know. Leotychidas, once our polemarch, was sent into exile for taking a bribe. He has sold the codes of the Thermopylai gate to the Sea Peoples for a sleeve full of gold.
The garrison at Thermopylai Citadel must hold the pass. They are few. They are hungry. Bring them what they need.

args.step: 3 Bring 6 Weapons and 10 Food to Thermopylai
3 Bring 6 Weapons and 10 Food to Thermopylai

args.text: Bring 6 Weapons and 10 Food to Thermopylai Citadel (Thermopylai system)

lines: Thermopylai: the hot gates. A narrow way between the mountains and the sea, where a few may hold back many - if they are fed, and armed, and do not run.

args.step: 3 Bring 6 Weapons and 10 Food to Thermopylai

lines: Bread and spears. Good. Now we can fight.
A merchant told me their ships will be so many that their guns will hide the stars. Then we shall fight in the shade. Take your place at the gate to Lukka.

args.step: 4 Hold the pass at the gate to Lukka
3 Bring 6 Weapons and 10 Food to Thermopylai

args.text: Still needed here: 6 Weapons, 10 Food

args.step: 4 Hold the pass at the gate to Lukka

args.text: Hold the pass at the gate to Lukka (Thermopylai system)

lines: They came through the narrow gate as a river comes through a gorge, and the Spartans stood in it like rocks.

args.step: 4 Hold the pass at the gate to Lukka

lines: First wave broken. They will send more. They always do.

args.step: 5 Hold the pass against the second wave
5 Hold the pass against the second wave

args.text: Hold the pass against the second wave (Thermopylai system)

args.step: 5 Hold the pass against the second wave

lines: There. The traitor's ship. He comes himself, to see what his gold has bought.

args.step: 6 Destroy the traitor Leotychidas and his es
6 Destroy the traitor Leotychidas and his es

args.text: Destroy the traitor Leotychidas and his escort (Thermopylai system)

lines: Spartans! I offer you what I was offered - gold, and your lives. Stand aside.

args.step: 6 Destroy the traitor Leotychidas and his es

lines: The gold in his sleeve did not save him. It never does; that was the meaning of the god's answer.
The pass holds. Now the Twin Stars. Kastor and Polydeukes, sons of Zeus, guard every sailor - their beacons at the Kastor Phalanx went dark when the raiders came. Relight them.

args.step: 7 Relight the beacons of the Twin Stars at K
7 Relight the beacons of the Twin Stars at K

args.text: Relight the beacons of the Twin Stars at Kastor Phalanx (Mantineia system)

lines: Two stars, side by side, that sailors look for when the storm is worst. Their beacons had gone out the night the traitor's raiders came.

args.step: 7 Relight the beacons of the Twin Stars at K

lines: When the Twin Stars burn on a ship's mast, sailors say, the storm is over. The pilot set them burning again, and every ship in the lanes saw them.
Bad news. At Tainaron, where the road to Hades opens, the three-headed hound has broken out. Herakles, father of our kings, dragged it up from below once. Now it is your turn.

args.step: 8 Drive Cerberus back into the dark at Taina
8 Drive Cerberus back into the dark at Taina

args.text: Drive Cerberus back into the dark at Tainaron (Tegea system)

lines: Three heads it had, and a mane of snakes, and its bark shook the hulls of ships as the bark of a dog shakes a sleeping house.

args.step: 8 Drive Cerberus back into the dark at Taina

lines: So the hound of Hades went back down the road it came, and the gate of Tainaron was shut.

args.step: 9 Return to Sparta Barracks
9 Return to Sparta Barracks

args.text: Return to Sparta Barracks (Sparta system)

lines: Come back. Report. Keep it short.

args.step: 9 Return to Sparta Barracks

lines: A Spartan mother tells her son, as she hands him his shield: 'With it, or on it.' You came back with yours.
Take this. Few strangers are called friends of Lakedaimon. You are.

rules.note: The quest begins at Mykenai Forge

args.step: Not started

lines: Sing, Muse, of Mykenai rich in gold, of its walls that the Cyclopes built, and of the curse that runs in its kings' blood like rust in a blade.
Stranger, you stand in the hall of the wanax. Drink from my cup - and then hear me, for the gods have turned their faces from my house.
The golden mask of my fathers was taken from the tholos-tomb, and the next night the Lion Gate's beacon went dark, and the great walls cracked.
Old Brontes, last of the Cyclops-engines, still tends the forge at Tiryns. He built these walls. Ask him what has broken them.

args.step: 1 Ask the Cyclops-engine Brontes at Tiryns
1 Ask the Cyclops-engine Brontes at Tiryns

args.text: Ask the Cyclops-engine Brontes at Tiryns (Mykenai system)

lines: Tiryns of the great walls: there the Cyclops-engine still beats its anvil, slow as a heart, as it has since the days of Perseus.

args.step: 1 Ask the Cyclops-engine Brontes at Tiryns

lines: One eye I have, and with it I have watched three thousand years. Walls do not crack by themselves, little one. A thief opened the tomb, and the dead were angry.
First mend the walls. Bring iron and titanium to the forge at the Lion Gate of Tirynthia, and I will set the stones as I set them for Perseus.

args.step: 2 Bring 10 Iron Ore and 6 Titanium Ore to Ti
2 Bring 10 Iron Ore and 6 Titanium Ore to Ti

args.text: Bring 10 Iron Ore and 6 Titanium Ore to Tirynthia Lion Gate (Tirynthia system)

lines: Iron for the bones of the wall, titanium for its sinews. Bring them, and I will make it whole.

args.step: 2 Bring 10 Iron Ore and 6 Titanium Ore to Ti

lines: The forge roared like a lion in a cave, and the walls grew whole again, stone locked on stone, so close that no knife-blade could pass between them.
The thieves took the mask towards the den of Lukka. Their sentries watch the gate from Mykenai. Clear the road.

args.text: Destroy the raiders watching the gate to Lukka (Mykenai system)

lines: The pass to Lukka: where the raiders watch, as crows watch a field from the top of a dead tree.

args.step: 3 Destroy the raiders watching the gate to L

lines: The road is open. But a worse thing stirs. In the marsh of Lerna, beside our own world, the many-headed serpent that Herakles killed has grown its heads again.
Herakles cut one head and two grew in its place. Do not be proud, pilot. Be patient.

args.step: 4 Destroy the Hydra in the marsh of Lerna
4 Destroy the Hydra in the marsh of Lerna

args.text: Destroy the Hydra in the marsh of Lerna (Mykenai system)

lines: Nine heads it had, and its breath was poison, and the marsh boiled where it moved.

args.step: 4 Destroy the Hydra in the marsh of Lerna

lines: So the Hydra died a second time; and the pilot did not boast of it, remembering what happens to the proud.
Now we sail to take back the mask. But the fleet cannot jump. The gates are still, as the winds were still at Aulis when Artemis was wronged.

args.step: 5 Ask the seer Kalchas why the gates are sti
5 Ask the seer Kalchas why the gates are sti

args.text: Ask the seer Kalchas why the gates are still (Atreus Tholos, Mykenai system)

lines: Kalchas sees what was, what is and what will be. He has never told a king good news. Go and hear him anyway.

args.step: 5 Ask the seer Kalchas why the gates are sti

lines: Artemis is angry. One of the wanax's captains shot a hind in her sacred grove and boasted that not even the goddess could shoot better.

Once, at Aulis, she asked for a king's daughter. But in the better telling she took a hind instead, and carried the girl away to safety. Give her gifts of healing and clean water, and she will be content.

args.step: 6 Bring 5 Medicine and 10 Water to Atreus Th
6 Bring 5 Medicine and 10 Water to Atreus Th

args.text: Bring 5 Medicine and 10 Water to Atreus Tholos for Artemis (Mykenai system)

lines: Medicine for her healing hands, water for her clean springs. Artemis loves the wild things, and those who keep them whole.

args.step: 6 Bring 5 Medicine and 10 Water to Atreus Th

lines: They gave the goddess her gifts, and the captain who boasted gave her his bow. And the gates woke, one after another, like hounds hearing the horn.
To Pylos! The thieves wait by the gate to Ugarit with the mask. Nestor's old city will see us pass.

args.step: 7 Destroy the thieves holding the golden mas
6 Bring 5 Medicine and 10 Water to Atreus Th

args.text: Still needed here: 5 Medicine, 10 Water

args.step: 7 Destroy the thieves holding the golden mas

args.text: Destroy the thieves holding the golden mask (Pylos system)

lines: Sandy Pylos, where old Nestor ruled - he who talked longest of all the Greeks at Troy, and was listened to, for he was wise.

args.step: 7 Destroy the thieves holding the golden mas

lines: The thieves fell, and the golden mask lay in the wreckage, still smiling its calm gold smile.
Bring it home - but beware the sea between. Once Poseidon sent a monster, Cetus, against the land of Andromeda, until Perseus of our house killed it. My dreams say it is out again.

args.step: 8 Kill Cetus, the sea-monster, near Argos
8 Kill Cetus, the sea-monster, near Argos

args.text: Kill Cetus, the sea-monster, near Argos (Pylos system)

lines: It rose from the dark as a whale rises from the deep, and its jaws could have swallowed a frigate whole.

args.step: 8 Kill Cetus, the sea-monster, near Argos

lines: So Cetus died, and the homecoming was free.

args.step: 9 Bring the golden mask home to Mykenai Forg
9 Bring the golden mask home to Mykenai Forg

args.text: Bring the golden mask home to Mykenai Forge (Mykenai system)

lines: And so the pilot came home with the mask, as Agamemnon came home from Troy - but to a kinder welcome.

args.step: 9 Bring the golden mask home to Mykenai Forg

lines: The mask is in the tomb again, and the Lion Gate burns. My fathers sleep.

Know this, guest: my house has a curse on it, from the day Atreus served his brother a terrible feast. Each king pays for the pride of the one before. You have bought us a little peace. Take gold for it - but take my friendship more.

scenarios.title: The First Principle
scenarios.description: The Ionian League's story: the sages ask what all things are made of. An eclipse is foretold, the League meets at the Panionion, Herostratos burns the temple of Artemis for fame, and Skylla rises in the dark.

rules.note: The quest begins at Miletos Agora

args.step: Not started

lines: Sing, Muse, of Ionia, where men first asked not which god made the world, but what the world is made of.
Welcome, guest. I write down the stories of the Greeks - which are many, and, it seems to me, mostly foolish. Yours I would like to hear when it is finished.
Thales of our city foretold an eclipse of the sun, and it came on the day he named. Now the observatories say another is coming - one that will blind the gate-beacons of the whole League for an hour.
Worse: a raider named Herostratos boasts he will do a deed so great that men will speak his name for ever. Such men are dangerous. The League's council meets at the Panionion. Go and tell them.

args.step: 1 Bring the warning to the League's council
1 Bring the warning to the League's council

args.text: Bring the warning to the League's council at the Panionion (Assos system)

lines: The Panionion stands on the headland of Mykale, where the twelve Ionian cities met each year to sacrifice to Poseidon and to quarrel.

args.step: 1 Bring the warning to the League's council

lines: Twelve cities sit in this council, and twelve cities never agree. But on this we agree: Ephesos must be guarded, and the eclipse must be measured, so that the gates can be steered by hand while it lasts.
Theano of Samos, who keeps the school of Pythagoras, is building the instrument. She needs parts. Bring them to the Sappho Observatory.

args.step: 2 Bring 4 Electronics and 6 Energy Cells to
2 Bring 4 Electronics and 6 Energy Cells to

args.text: Bring 4 Electronics and 6 Energy Cells to Sappho Observatory (Samos system)

args.step: 2 Bring 4 Electronics and 6 Energy Cells to

lines: Pythagoras taught that all things are number: the strings of the lyre, the rings of the planets, even justice. This instrument hears the numbers of the sky, and will tell us the second the shadow falls.
Herostratos's scouts have been seen at Ephesos, by the strait. Drive them off before they learn too much.

args.step: 3 Drive off Herostratos's scouts at the stra
2 Bring 4 Electronics and 6 Energy Cells to

args.step: 3 Drive off Herostratos's scouts at the stra

args.text: Drive off Herostratos's scouts at the strait of Lukka (Ephesos system)

lines: Be quick and be careful. A man who wants to be remembered will do anything to be noticed.

args.step: 3 Drive off Herostratos's scouts at the stra

lines: The scouts carried fire-charges, the kind used to burn a station. Pilot - it is the temple of Artemis he means to burn. It is the greatest wonder of the League. Hurry to the temple-ring beside Ephesos Agora.

args.step: 4 Guard the temple-ring of Artemis beside Ep
4 Guard the temple-ring of Artemis beside Ep

args.text: Guard the temple-ring of Artemis beside Ephesos Agora (Ephesos system)

lines: The temple of Artemis at Ephesos had a hundred and twenty-seven columns, each the gift of a king. Its ring now shone in the dark beside the Agora like a crown laid on black cloth.

args.step: 4 Guard the temple-ring of Artemis beside Ep

lines: Too late to stop him reaching us - not too late to stop him finishing. He is here. Hear him.
Let them burn my body afterwards! My name will outlive their temple, their League and their gods.

args.step: 5 Destroy Herostratos before he burns the te
5 Destroy Herostratos before he burns the te

args.text: Destroy Herostratos before he burns the temple of Artemis (Ephesos system)

lines: Burn, ring of Artemis! Let the whole League see the fire, and say my name!

args.step: 5 Destroy Herostratos before he burns the te

lines: So Herostratos fell, and the temple stood, though its outer ring smoked for days.
The Ephesians have decreed that his name shall never be spoken or written again. That is the punishment the gods give the proud: what they wanted most, taken from them.
And yet I have just written it down. Well - a chronicler must. Now: the eclipse. Theano's instrument is at Miletos; be at the Pythagoras Artemision before the shadow falls.

args.step: 6 Reach the Pythagoras Artemision before the
6 Reach the Pythagoras Artemision before the

args.text: Reach the Pythagoras Artemision before the eclipse (Miletos system)

lines: The pilot flew towards Miletos, and behind the ship the light of the sun began, very slowly, to be eaten.

args.step: 6 Reach the Pythagoras Artemision before the

args.text: Too late - but fly on all the same.

args.step: 6 Reach the Pythagoras Artemision before the

lines: In time! The numbers are true; the gates are steered. Thales would be proud - though he would pretend not to be.

args.step: 6 Reach the Pythagoras Artemision before the

lines: The shadow came first - but the gates held, by luck and by the gods' patience. Next time, be quicker than luck.

args.step: 6 Reach the Pythagoras Artemision before the

lines: And in the hour of the eclipse, when the stars came out at noon, something rose out of the strait of Lukka - six heads on long necks, and a girdle of barking dogs.
Skylla. Homer sang of her. Odysseus lost six men to her and could not fight her. You, at least, have guns.

args.step: 7 Destroy Skylla at the strait of Lukka
7 Destroy Skylla at the strait of Lukka

args.text: Destroy Skylla at the strait of Lukka (Ephesos system)

lines: As a fisherman on a rock lets down his line and pulls up a fish, so she stooped from the dark and pulled ships from the lane.

args.step: 7 Destroy Skylla at the strait of Lukka

lines: So Skylla sank back into the strait, and the eclipse passed, and the sun came back to Ionia.

args.step: 8 Hear the singer at Homeros Odeon
8 Hear the singer at Homeros Odeon

args.text: Hear the singer at Homeros Odeon (Ephesos system)

lines: The singer at the Odeon has asked for you. Singers do not usually ask - they are usually asked. Go.

args.step: 8 Hear the singer at Homeros Odeon

lines: Sit, guest. I am a singer, as my fathers were. I have made a new song - about a pilot, a burned temple that did not burn, and a monster that Odysseus could not kill.
What is everything made of? Thales said water, Anaximenes air, Herakleitos fire, Pythagoras number. I say: stories. Take the League's gold - the song is free.

scenarios.title: The Wandering Isle
scenarios.description: The Cycladic Isles' story: sacred Delos breaks from its four pillars and drifts, as it did before Leto bore Apollo and Artemis there. Tithes, obsidian, marble and Ariadne's crown - and Echidna, sent by Hera.

rules.note: The quest begins at Delos Circle

args.step: Not started

lines: Sing, Muse, of the Isles that stand in a circle round holy Delos, as dancers stand round an altar.

Once Delos was a floating island, driven by every wind. When Leto, carrying the children of Zeus, wandered the world, no land would take her in - for they feared white-armed Hera. Only Delos dared. Then Poseidon fixed it to the sea's floor with four pillars, and there Apollo and Artemis were born.
Guest, the Circle welcomes you - though you find us frightened. The four pillar-engines that anchor Delos are failing. The station has begun to drift, as the island drifted before the god was born.

Each pillar was made with a gift from one isle: Siphnos gave gold, Melos obsidian, Paros marble, Naxos the vine. We must gather the gifts again. Begin with Siphnos - and remember what happened to the Siphnians who cheated the god.

args.step: 1 Bring a true tithe of 6 Platinum Ore to Si
1 Bring a true tithe of 6 Platinum Ore to Si

args.text: Bring a true tithe of 6 Platinum Ore to Siphnos Circle (Siphnos system)

lines: The Siphnians grew rich from their gold mines, and each year sent Apollo a golden egg. One year they sent gilded lead. The sea came into their mines, and they were rich no longer.
A guest from the Circle! Sit; you shall have bread and figs before you have business. Then weigh your metal on our scales, and weigh it fairly.

args.step: 1 Bring a true tithe of 6 Platinum Ore to Si

lines: True metal, honestly weighed. Our grandfathers should have done as much. The first pillar has its gift.
Melos guards the black glass, obsidian - sharper than any bronze. But raiders have been robbing its quarries. Go carefully.

args.step: 2 Drive the obsidian thieves from Melos
1 Bring a true tithe of 6 Platinum Ore to Si

args.text: Still needed here: 6 Platinum Ore

args.step: 2 Drive the obsidian thieves from Melos

args.text: Drive the obsidian thieves from Melos (Melos system)

lines: Melos: an island of black glass, whose people cut it into knives and arrow-heads long before the first smith blew on a fire.

args.step: 2 Drive the obsidian thieves from Melos

lines: Our black glass is safe again. Take the best of it for the second pillar. Now Paros - the marble-cutters there are waiting for you.

args.step: 3 Find the marble-cutters on Saliagos
3 Find the marble-cutters on Saliagos

args.text: Find the marble-cutters on Saliagos (Paros system)

lines: Paros. Its marble is so white that sculptors say it glows from inside. Ask for Arkesilas - he will complain, then help.

args.step: 3 Find the marble-cutters on Saliagos

lines: You want marble for a pillar? Then you want white marble, the finest there is - not stone, light that has gone hard. But my cutters need metal for their saws.

args.step: 4 Bring 8 Titanium Ore to Paros Circle for t
4 Bring 8 Titanium Ore to Paros Circle for t

args.text: Bring 8 Titanium Ore to Paros Circle for the marble-cutters (Paros system)

lines: Bring metal. Not much - marble is patient, but my saws are not.

args.step: 4 Bring 8 Titanium Ore to Paros Circle for t

lines: The third pillar has its marble. One isle is left: Naxos, where Dionysos found Ariadne weeping on the shore, and crowned her with stars.

args.step: 5 Seek the vine-crown on Aplomata
4 Bring 8 Titanium Ore to Paros Circle for t

args.text: Still needed here: 8 Titanium Ore

args.step: 5 Seek the vine-crown on Aplomata

args.text: Seek the vine-crown on Aplomata (Naxia system)

lines: Theseus left Ariadne asleep on Naxos and sailed for Athens. When she woke, his ship was a speck on the sea. But the god Dionysos came with his singing train, and made her his wife.

args.step: 5 Seek the vine-crown on Aplomata

lines: This is her crown - the one the god set in the sky as a ring of stars when she died. A copy, but a holy one. Take it to Delos; it is the fourth gift.
But be warned. The white-armed queen of the gods has not forgotten Leto. She sent the serpent after her once. She has sent another.

args.step: 6 Destroy Echidna, sent by Hera, before Delo
6 Destroy Echidna, sent by Hera, before Delo

args.text: Destroy Echidna, sent by Hera, before Delos Circle (Delos system)

lines: Half a nymph she was, with lovely cheeks and bright eyes, and half a dreadful serpent - Echidna, mother of monsters, coiling round the drifting ring.
Leto's children were born on that rock against my will. Let the rock drift, and let it sink.
Do not answer her, pilot. One does not argue with the queen of the gods. One simply wins.

args.step: 6 Destroy Echidna, sent by Hera, before Delo

lines: So the serpent fell, as Python fell to Apollo's arrows; and the ring of Delos stood still on its pillars once more.

args.step: 7 Raise the four pillars at Delos Circle
7 Raise the four pillars at Delos Circle

args.text: Raise the four pillars at Delos Circle (Delos system)

lines: Then the pilot brought the four gifts to Delos: gold, black glass, white marble and the vine-crown of Ariadne.

args.step: 7 Raise the four pillars at Delos Circle

lines: Gold, obsidian, marble and the vine. The pillars are raised. Delos stands where Leto found her rest, and the god's light burns in the Circle.
One rite remains. On Keros, the old people broke their marble figures and laid them down, all together, in one place. We still do. Bring the offering there.

args.step: 8 Bring 3 Luxury Goods to Keros Quarry for t
8 Bring 3 Luxury Goods to Keros Quarry for t

args.text: Bring 3 Luxury Goods to Keros Quarry for the rite of broken figures (Keros system)

lines: Keros: a small island where nobody lives, and where, for a thousand years, the people of the Isles came to break what they had made.

args.step: 8 Bring 3 Luxury Goods to Keros Quarry for t

lines: They broke the white figures with their folded arms and their quiet faces, and laid the pieces down together, as their fathers had for a thousand years. No one now knows why. Perhaps it does not matter.
The Isles are one circle again. Take our thanks, guest - and our gold, which is honest.

args.step: 8 Bring 3 Luxury Goods to Keros Quarry for t
